peeler noun

our formation

īnstrūmentum, īnstrūmentī n. ad pōma dēcorticanda

tool for peeling fruit

Our explicit description for a peeler, not a verified fixed technical name. Dēcorticō is ancient, but the complete peeler phrase is composed here.

See also peel, tool, kitchen knife.
